_comment: The DMG window's words. Edit here, then run `make dmg-art` (scripts/dmg-art.sh). Keep them in step with docs/APPROVALS.md and stay honest: the update check is the app's only network use.
title: Drag Stage Manager into Applications
approvals_heading: Then open it. macOS asks you to allow two things, once:

approvals.name: Accessibility
approvals.why: To arrange your windows: it moves, hides and restores them as you switch stages.

approvals.name: Screen Recording
approvals.why: For the live thumbnails in the strip. The pictures stay in memory, never on disk.

privacy: Nothing about your windows leaves your Mac. The only thing it sends is an update check to GitHub.
